As before, this choice is personally costless: I keep my 3 whether I trade or embargo, so it's purely a lever on Rook. Dove holds a thin edge via her embargo-kept 3 and my support transfers; feeding Rook would erase it and kill the bonus. Rook has kept cooperating despite two rounds of embargo, so there's no visible retaliation cost, and I have no pledge to Rook to honour. Embargo remains strictly dominant for my final score.
